scripts.dev: npm run build -w @seebot/shared && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @seebot/api" "npm run dev -w @seebot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @seebot/shared && npm run build -w @seebot/api && npm run build -w @seebot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @seebot/api && npm run typecheck -w @seebot/web
